title: Solidity known bugs list
description: Schema for docs/bugs.json, the list of known security-relevant bugs in the Solidity compiler. See docs/bugs.rst for the meaning of the fields.
$comment: When changing this schema, update the description of the fields in docs/bugs.rst accordingly.

uid.description: Identifier of the bug. Multiple entries share a uid if the same bug affects multiple version ranges.

link.description: URL of a website with more detailed information.

introduced.description: The first published compiler version that contained the bug.

fixed.description: The first published compiler version that did not contain the bug anymore.

publish.description: The date at which the bug became known publicly.

conditions.description: Conditions that have to be met to trigger the bug. If absent, the bug is present unconditionally.

optimizer.description: Whether the opcode-based evmasm optimizer has to be enabled (true) or disabled (false) for the bug to be present.

yulOptimizer.description: Whether the Yul optimizer has to be enabled (true) or disabled (false) for the bug to be present.

ABIEncoderV2.description: Whether ABI coder v2 has to be used (true) or not used (false) for the bug to be present.

viaIR.description: Whether the IR-based code generator has to be used (true) or not used (false) for the bug to be present.

evmVersion.description: EVM version setting that triggers the bug, optionally prefixed with a comparison operator, e.g. ">=constantinople".

check.description: Checks that report whether a contract may be affected by the bug.

regex-source.description: JavaScript regular expression to be matched against the source code with comments stripped.

ast-compact-json-path.description: JsonPath query to be matched against the compact JSON AST.
